criterion: whether the formula contains symbols that commit to physical dimensions; exemption does not mean skipping review -- the review lens differs per tier

notation.form: coherent SI symbols or base-unit power products (e.g. m*s^-1)

supersedes: single-tier exempt list registered 2026-11-12 (3 rows, now tiered with the same ids)

agnostic.rule: abstract analysis statements: symbolic mappings are kept but no units are presupposed; any later unit assignment must leave the whole equation self-consistent (engine check_law lens: consistency-only, no dimension presupposition)

exempt.rule: pure logical/quantified/set-theoretic statements carry no SI dimension semantics; exempted from unit review entirely (si_units intentionally left empty, no candidate derivation)

rule_defined.rule: function-notation family rules: trigonometric functions require dimensionless arguments; norm/modulus dimensions follow their arguments and are never preset to 1; these rows stay out of unit-value review until the function-notation engine-support milestone (M1) lands, and are NOT exempt; sqrt rule (added 2026-11-12): dimensions of sqrt follow the half power of its argument, and sqrt is 1 only when its argument is dimensionless -- the function-notation family is amended together with the M1 milestone
